newsitem.title: USA: Columbus Realty ends $24 mln stock sale.
newsitem.headline: Columbus Realty ends $24 mln stock sale.

text.p: Columbus Realty Trust said it had sold 1.17 million common shares of beneficial interest at a price of $20.50 per share.
Columbus said it would use the proceeds from the sale of about $24 million to repay floating rate debt incurred as a result of the development of new properties.

Columbus Realty Trust, headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that owns 26 apartment communities representing 5,414 operating rental units and 1,368 units under construction.
